# OA v0.7.25

**Status:** C++ release snapshot; Python wheel publication blocked

**Release date:** 2026-08-29

**Source:** [`v0.7.25`](https://github.com/realminc/oa/releases/tag/v0.7.25)

## Summary

OA v0.7.25 is the immutable hosted-release repair for the blocked v0.7.24
native Vulkan Video candidate. It publishes the same codec-profile admission,
8/10-bit fixtures, P010 paths, hardware sampler-YCbCr display conversion,
stable frame stepping, and 1080p60/UHD60 qualification.

Video APIs, media assets, decode and presentation behavior, and recorded
performance evidence are unchanged from v0.7.24.

## Fixed

- Removed the experimental `CvtNv12YcbcrToBf16` shader from the compiled
  fixed-kernel registry because the public conversion route does not dispatch
  it. Vision kernel ID 3 remains reserved and cannot be reused accidentally.
- Changed validation's default logger from a legacy `%s` call to OA's brace
  formatting contract. This prevents validation messages from aborting the
  sanitizer suite and isolated Python wheel smoke test.

## Video coverage

The qualified Intel Iris Xe TGL GT2 / Mesa 26.1.7 matrix remains:

- H.264 Baseline, Main, and High, 8-bit 4:2:0;
- H.265 Main 8, Main 10 P010, and Range Extensions profile-IDC-4 8/10-bit
  4:2:0 single-picture streams;
- AV1 Main 8 and the admitted Main 10 P010 subset;
- VP9 Profile 0 and Profile 2 P010 single-picture streams.

H.265 Main Still Picture remains fixture-gated. Profiles and chroma/depth
combinations not exposed by this device remain capability-gated rather than
synthetically admitted.

## Verification

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Shader authority | 370 embedded shaders; zero fixed kernels without production references |
| Generator ownership | Kernel generator tests pass; 152 generated outputs reproduce without drift |
| Focused host contract | Release and UBSAN validation tests pass |
| Runtime registry | Generated registry and hybrid YCbCr layout tests pass |
| Hosted release | Full build/packages, ASAN, UBSAN, CPU Vulkan, release assets, and checksums passed; Python wheel smoke failed in the compute-only fallback warning, so PyPI and wheel attachment were skipped |

The complete codec correctness, Vulkan validation, and benchmark evidence is
unchanged and remains in the [v0.7.24 source note](v0.7.24.md) and
[video benchmark](../benchmarks/oaVideo.md).

## Compatibility and migration

No public video API changes in this repair. The direct hardware-sampler BF16
kernel was never an admitted production route. Rebuild native and Python
consumers and discard pre-1.0 binary, pipeline, execution-plan, and media
session caches.

## Known limitations

- H.265 Main Still Picture is fixture-gated on the qualified host.
- H.264 4:4:4; H.265 4:2:2/4:4:4/12-bit/SCC; AV1 High/Professional; and VP9
  Profiles 1/3 are unavailable on the qualified device.
- AV1 Main 10 loop restoration remains rejected before submission.
- Direct hardware YCbCr-to-BF16 tensor conversion remains experimental source,
  not a compiled or dispatched product path. Hardware YCbCr-to-RGBA remains the
  default qualified presentation route.
- Broader encode and cross-vendor qualification require additional hardware.

## Upgrade

Rebuild OA and its consumers, regenerate owned bindings and examples, and keep
runtime codec/profile checks enabled. Treat `Unavailable` as an explicit
capability result.
